description: Helm chart for the community Cloudflare Operator (adyanth/cloudflare-operator) that reconciles Tunnel, ClusterTunnel, AccessTunnel and TunnelBinding CRDs against Cloudflare Zero Trust / Cloudflare Tunnel. Optionally renders a ClusterOriginIssuer for use with the cert-manager origin-ca-issuer.
ISMS Builder on Kubernetes - the open-source ISO 27001 / NIS2 ISMS template builder, digest-pinned, non-root, persistent, network-restricted by default, with managed-secret guardrails.
A local interface for text generation LLMs.
